dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains long-term monthly monitoring birding records at the UBC Botanical Garden from 2017 to 2026. Observations are specified to garden area.
Surveys coordinated by Bev Ramey (Nature Vancouver) and Tara Moreau (UBC Botanical Gardens), data curation and archiving by Adriana Lopez Villalobos, Grace Gooding, and Mina Lander (UBC Botanical Garden). The dataset contains 10476 rows and 17 columns and was standardized and collated from monthly spreadsheets into one comprehensive dataset. A secondary dataset containing additional notes regarding surveys is also included.
This dataset supports ecological research and habitat monitoring.
dct_title_s: UBC Botanical Garden Nature Vancouver, Long-term Monthly Bird Monitoring Records (2017-2026)
